lede: The Mountain Village Town Council meets October 15 for second reading of an ordinance that changes how MVHA housing fees are set — shifting from hardcoded figures to an annual fee schedule — alongside a resolution adopting the actual 2027 fee schedules, which is real money affecting real workforce housing. Alongside that, the Ouray County Commissioners take up Prop 123 affordable housing commitments and a Special Use Permit amendment on October 13, and the Telluride Town Council spends three hours on the 2027 budget — housing programs, open space, enterprise funds — before any formal adoption vote.

notable.stake: Cossey Complaint hearing and two executive legal sessions on water rights.
